insights.title: variables.ts carries a zero-import invariant that must be preserved
insights.content: `src/engine/variables.ts` has no `import` statements — this is a deliberate architectural invariant, not an accident. When extending the variable resolution engine, all logic must remain self-contained within `resolveVariables()`. Resist abstracting single-function changes into new modules or adding utility imports; both would break the invariant. This constraint shaped the escape-syntax implementation in 2026-05-31-variable-escape-syntax: the escape branch was added inline rather than delegated, precisely to preserve zero-dependency status.

insights.title: constraints.md Template Syntax table is the authoritative contract for template syntax
insights.content: `docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md` contains a Template Syntax table that serves as the authoritative reference for all supported template markers in this project. Every new syntax addition must include a corresponding row in this table as a first-class acceptance criterion — not a follow-up documentation task. This file is the primary source agents consult for syntax rules; failing to update it leaves a discrepancy between the engine's behavior and the project contract that agents rely on.
